mails.body:
Hi,

Thanks for being part of the Expert Circle network! Given your experience, I thought you could support a client researching the market for workflow software: trends, competition and budgets.

If this is a good fit, please answer the screening questions below:
1. Are you familiar with the main vendors in this market?
2. Who competes most head-to-head?
3. Would you be comfortable with a recorded call? (Yes/No)
4. Your availability over the next week?

Best,
Maya
Analyst, Expert Call Services

Click unsubscribe to be removed from all future consulting opportunities.
